A daily Bible reading plan for a year

Open a month and read the listed chapters in your own Bible. This calendar-year plan covers 66 books from Genesis through Revelation.

See the plan

How the yearly plan works

The 1,189 chapters are divided across the calendar year, usually three or four chapters a day. The sequence follows book order, not a reconstructed chronology of events. Chapter lengths vary, so daily reading time will vary too.

This plan covers the 66-book canon. If your Bible contains additional books, schedule separate reading for those books. Check Psalm numbering against your edition.

Chapters for every day 2026

Every month is available without signing in. Open a month to see its dates and chapters.

Starting after January

You can begin with today’s date and return to earlier chapters later, or start at the first entry and keep your own pace. If you choose the second approach, your finish date will no longer be tied to December 31.

When you miss a day

You do not have to catch up in one long sitting. Return to the last passage you read and continue. After reading, write down one observation or question that you would like to revisit.
